units.source_zh: “决不要懈怠，直到你父亲有指示过来。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 听到这个消息，浓姬才离开信忠，回到内庭。“决不要懈怠，直到你父亲有指示过来。”

paragraphs.source_en: The rumors she had ordered spread must now be striking terror into the Azai army, for they had failed to intercept Nobunaga—an uncanny feeling welled up in Nōhime’s heart. Nobunaga advanced with breathtaking speed and retreated like a flash of lightning; one could only marvel at him. The Asakura clan’s attack did not appear to have achieved the effect they had expected. Nobunaga’s decision to return to the capital rather than Gifu Castle made that perfectly clear.

units.source_en: The rumors she had ordered spread must now be striking terror into the Azai army, for they had failed to intercept Nobunaga—an uncanny feeling welled up in Nōhime’s heart.

units.source_zh: 她令人传出去的那些谣言，现在无疑正让浅井军心惊胆战，因为他们没有成功地截住信长—— 一种不可思议的感觉涌上浓姬的心头。

units.source_zh: 信长进攻时日进千里，撤退时亦如电光石火，令人不得不佩服。

units.source_en: The Asakura clan’s attack did not appear to have achieved the effect they had expected.
units.source_zh: 朝仓氏的进攻似乎并未达到预期的效果。

units.source_en: Nobunaga’s decision to return to the capital rather than Gifu Castle made that perfectly clear.
units.source_zh: 信长既然不回岐阜城，而决定返回京城，就已经清楚地说明了这一点。

paragraphs.source_zh: 她令人传出去的那些谣言，现在无疑正让浅井军心惊胆战，因为他们没有成功地截住信长—— 一种不可思议的感觉涌上浓姬的心头。信长进攻时日进千里，撤退时亦如电光石火，令人不得不佩服。朝仓氏的进攻似乎并未达到预期的效果。信长既然不回岐阜城，而决定返回京城，就已经清楚地说明了这一点。

paragraphs.source_en: Upon returning to the inner quarters, Nōhime immediately summoned the three concubines to her room. Rain had been falling since that morning. The pear blossoms in the garden breathed out waves of fragrance through the misty rain.

paragraphs.source_zh: 回到内庭后，浓姬立刻将三个侧室叫到自己房中。从这天早上就开始下雨。庭院中的梨花在烟雨濛濛中吐露阵阵芳香。

paragraphs.source_en: Orui, Miyuki, and Nana arrived one after another. Nōhime studied them; she hated none of them. They had once been rivals for Nobunaga’s favor and had aroused her jealousy, but that was now part of the distant past.

units.source_en: Orui, Miyuki, and Nana arrived one after another. Nōhime studied them; she hated none of them.
units.source_zh: 阿类、深雪和奈奈先后到来，浓姬打量着她们，她不恨她们中的任何一个。

units.source_en: They had once been rivals for Nobunaga’s favor and had aroused her jealousy, but that was now part of the distant past.

ja.t: かせたこともあった。だが、それはもう

units.source_zh: 她们以前曾经是与浓姬争宠的对手，让她生起过嫉妒，但那已成遥远的往事。

paragraphs.source_zh: 阿类、深雪和奈奈先后到来，浓姬打量着她们，她不恨她们中的任何一个。她们以前曾经是与浓姬争宠的对手，让她生起过嫉妒，但那已成遥远的往事。

paragraphs.source_en: “I have good news for you: our lord has safely withdrawn from Echizen and reached Kyoto. You may set your minds at ease.”

units.source_en: “I have good news for you: our lord has safely withdrawn from Echizen and reached Kyoto.
units.source_zh: “有件喜事告诉你们：大人已经平安撤离越前，到了京都。

units.source_en: You may set your minds at ease.”
units.source_zh: 你们可以放心了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “有件喜事告诉你们：大人已经平安撤离越前，到了京都。你们可以放心了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Oh, he withdrew safely!”

units.source_en: “Oh, he withdrew safely!”
units.source_zh: “啊，平安撤退了！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “啊，平安撤退了！”

paragraphs.source_en: “As I thought, Great Bodhisattva Hachiman is protecting our lord.”

units.source_en: “As I thought, Great Bodhisattva Hachiman is protecting our lord.”
units.source_zh: “八幡大菩萨果然在保佑主公。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “八幡大菩萨果然在保佑主公。”

paragraphs.source_en: Miyuki, who had once served as Nōhime’s maid, remained silent, while Orui and Nana were already leaping for joy. Nōhime watched the scene before her with a smile. These women were not Nōhime’s enemies but her attendants, innocent and guileless. Not only did they acknowledge Nōhime’s unshakable position as the lawful wife, but they harbored no ambition and entertained not the slightest doubt about their own destinies.

paragraphs.source_zh: 曾经是浓姬侍女的深雪沉默不语，而阿类和奈奈已经欢喜雀跃。浓姬面带微笑地看着眼前这一切。这些女人不是浓姬的敌人，而是她的侍女，如此天真无邪。她们不但承认正室浓姬不可动摇的地位，而且没有任何野心，对各自的命运也没有丝毫怀疑。

paragraphs.source_en: “Why did our lord withdraw to the capital instead of returning to Gifu?” Nana asked.

units.source_en: “Why did our lord withdraw to the capital instead of returning to Gifu?”
units.source_zh: “大人为什么不回岐阜，却撤到京城呢？”

units.source_en: Nana asked.

paragraphs.source_zh: “大人为什么不回岐阜，却撤到京城呢？”奈奈问。

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes, why…?” Orui, too, raised her eyes to Nōhime. They waited attentively, eager to hear Nōhime explain the matter in detail.
